title: Stabilize Windows worktree targeted-reconcile detection under full-suite Git load
outcome: The Batch41 worktree reconcile test reliably observes the intended targeted Windows path under concurrent full-suite load, or reports a typed Git fallback cause instead of an unexplained full sweep.
acceptance: A transient ChangedFiles or DirtyFiles failure is attributable by a stable test/diagnostic signal.
IndexWorktreeSeedsReconcilesCommitsAndDirtWithoutTouchingMain passes repeatedly inside the uninterrupted full five-project suite.
